label: Live drift observed: code-standards-alignment.md:76 cites runtime/handlers/save/spec-folder-mutex.ts:10 as defining const SPEC_FOLDER_LOCKS, but line 10 is an import line and the definition is at line 22. Path existence and line-range bounds both pass; only a token-at-line check fails it. The cell is also a bare-relative citation in a prose bullet, so it is outside the four-prefix gate and outside the File-column scope of the proposed extension.

Corpus replay of the proposed catalog anchor check: 36 path:line anchors across 6 catalog files; 34 resolve and are within bounds; 0 out-of-bounds; the 2 unresolved are bare-relative citations of files annotated '(removed with the memory server)' at code-standards-alignment.md:66 and :69. Retaining and bounds-checking the parsed range at the strip site is corpus-safe (0 fires today); widening existence checks to bare-relative paths would fire on deliberate deleted-file history unless the check honors the removal annotation.

The catalog validator gate is pinned by direct read: REPO_RELATIVE_PREFIXES has exactly four prefixes (line 547), LINE_RANGE_SUFFIX_RE at line 552, _extract_checkable_path at 561 accepts only those prefixes or doc-relative markdown links, and check_source_file_paths strips the line suffix at 593 and classifies existence only at 595. Iteration 4's placement and existence-only characterization are verified.

Option-check attribution measured across all 57 playbook trees: nearest-mention attribution yields 1085 script/flag pairs with 273 not-found (55 distinct flags, 92 files) whose sampled head is entirely provenance artifacts (e.g. --prompt bound to skill-advisor.cjs, --config/--project bound to lookup-trigger-index.mjs, --force in a refusal scenario); strict same-line attribution yields 1 pair, itself prose; naive fenced-block scoping yields 0. Attribution grammar, not the flag comparison, is the load-bearing cost and sets the true-positive ceiling.
